$comment: Shape of one rule file (rules/<name>.yaml). The checks that need more than a schema (ownership conventions, pointer roots, limits, capability cards) are in packages/rules-cli.

name.description: Must equal the file name without extension.

owner.description: The principal that owns the subscription: automation/<name> for a rule with a reaction, the agent for an agent subscription.

selector.description: Glob over the topic; * matches any run of characters including dots.

path.description: JSON pointer into the event payload (/data/..., /topic, /source, /key, /classification, /verified, /depth).

wake.description: Stated explicitly on every rule: whether a match wakes the owner.

input.description: Task input. Strings may contain ${/json/pointer} references into the event payload.

status.description: Leave out to keep whatever the domain has; see rules/README.md.
